# Twelve questions, before you start

Answer these now, in whatever form you like: a word, a sentence, a sketch, or "no idea". You will answer the same twelve again at the end of the course and put the two side by side. **They measure how far you travel, never what you are worth.** Nothing is scored, and "I don't know yet" is a perfectly good answer today.

Keep your answers. At the end, they are the "before" picture.
